niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel light, airy, polished, and structurally complete, with clear hierarchy, moderate content richness, consistent row-based organization, soft integrated surfaces, and restrained contemporary styling. They often favor calm, supportive tone, open spacing, and coherent full-screen composition over fragmented, noisy, or unfinished layouts.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that look fully populated and complete, with many visible options, coherent sections, and no empty or placeholder-feeling areas.
Prefers clearly separated sections, labeled groupings, and an orderly top-to-bottom hierarchy that makes the screen easy to scan.
Prefers open spacing, visual breathing room, and balanced distribution of content rather than cramped or top-heavy layouts.
Prefers subtle, low-contrast containers that blend into the page, avoiding stark boxed cards or harsh background/container separation.
Prefers muted, refined, contemporary styling with restrained accents and a polished finish rather than loud, toy-like, decorative, or overly branded treatment.
Prefers uniform row-based lists with steady spacing, consistent affordances, and smooth scan rhythm instead of chunky card groupings or irregular flow.
Prefers reassuring, friendly, conversational wording and gentler emotional framing over alarmist, punitive, or overly severe presentation.
Prefers screens where each element clearly communicates its purpose and the overall composition feels finished, coherent, and intentionally productized.
